title: Can large language models be privacy preserving and fair medical coders?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance gap (Micro F1, Parity, Recall) between male and female patients in ICD code classification on the MIMIC-III dataset, specifically comparing how differentially private training affects these disparities.

Evaluating the performance gap (Micro F1, Parity, Recall) across different ethnic groups (White, Black, Hispanic, Asian) in ICD code classification on the MIMIC-III dataset, specifically comparing how differentially private training affects these disparities.
